overview: A Cheetah's Pride follows a pair of warring cheetahs as they fight for possession of their cubs.
title: A Cheetah's Pride

overview: When publisher and editor-in-chief Valeria Krylova beat out her rival, media magnate Akhmet Bashirov, at the awards ceremony for the best journalists of the year, she had no idea how closely their fates would bind them together. The next day, banker Sadovnikov will be killed under strange circumstances, and both heroes will fall under suspicion of committing the crime: each, according to the investigation, will have compelling motives. Moreover, everything points to the fact that the contract killer was Vasily, a friend of Valeria's close friend, writer Melissa Sinitskaya. And while Melissa and Vasily are hiding in a country house, Valeria is kidnapped. Bashirov's security guard tries to figure out the crime.

overview: This is a story about a simple student named Lech. He falls in love with the daughter of the most influential businessman in the city and, having disrupted her birthday, gets a round sum. To try to get the money back, Lech gathers a team of friends and decides to sell fake clothes. Whether it will be possible to repay the debt or the thirst for profit will put the lives of people close to Lech on the line, we will find out very soon.

overview: After her brother's murder, Mehrunisa seeks justice against influential figures trying to cover up the truth, facing deceit and corruption along the way.

overview: The hidden side of justice. The day-to-day operations of the law enforcement agency that investigates crimes committed by the police itself.

overview: A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

overview: Pro Moves is a brand-new series from First We Feast, where food TV icon Adam Richman shares the tips, tricks, and insider information needed to get the most out of any eating experience. From how to spot the freshest pie at the pizzeria, to the best way to navigate the complexities of a steakhouse menu, Adam has you covered so you can act like the ultimate regular. Over the course of his storied career, Adam has amassed a wealth of culinary knowledge that he's eager to share. But he's also enlisting a few expert guests and celebrity pals—folks Frank Pinello, Scott Wiener, and Emmy Award-winning steakhouse aficionado Bryan Cranston—to help him along the way.
title: Pro Moves

overview: An international conspiracy is brewing by a number of countries that want to discredit Russia, accuse it of environmental crimes in the polar zone, such as testing chemical and other weapons, and deprive it of access to the Arctic. For this purpose, a daring series of sabotage is planned: the seizure of a nuclear icebreaker, the undermining of the ice floe on which the Russian scientific station North Pole operates, the mining and capture by sabotage divers of a secret underwater facility, an attack on ice-class tankers and much more.
title: Морские дьяволы. Полярный конвой

overview: In 2011, the Creators (a.k.a. Mike and Jerry) declared to the Penny Arcade office that a reality show based on webcomics must be done. After a year of research and a successful Kickstarter stretch goal, the stage had been set for 12 Artists flown from around the world to compete for $15,000 in cash and a year integrated into the Penny Arcade machine. This series airs on Penny Arcade's site and YouTube every Tuesday & Friday.
title: Strip Search

overview: The documentary series takes an unusual look at the most breathtaking bridge structures man has built. It shows the almost super human effort it takes to design and build these giants. The series goes behind the scenes and shows how much effort the unique structures require to function smoothly every day.
title: Giant Constructions

overview: Moonwalk follows two thieves, Tarik Pandey and Maddy Kapoor, as they go head-to-head to steal the heart of a local heartthrob, Chandini Lakhani. Their rivalry and competition lead to dangerous yet hilarious consequences and something far more valuable...and out of this world- a piece of rock from the Moon that lands on Earth!
title: Moonwalk

overview: Doctors is set at the high-stakes Elizabeth Blackwell Medical Centre in Mumbai, where Dr. Nitya Vasu begins her surgical residency with a personal vendetta against Dr. Ishaan Ahuja, believing he is responsible for her brother's disability. However, as she works alongside him, Nitya realizes Ishaan is not the villain she thought, and her animosity turns to attraction. The series explores intense medical cases and the personal struggles of residents, including ambition, love, and betrayal. The season culminates in shifting relationships, with old enemies becoming allies, a tragic event reshaping the group, and Nitya and Ishaan's love emerging at great personal cost.
title: Doctors

overview: Customs officers fight against drug smuggling at airports, air cargo inspection facilities and the international mail center.
title: To Catch a Smuggler: South Pacific

overview: Ellen, which was titled These Friends of Mine during its first season, is comedy about the life of a young woman by the name of Ellen Morgan-a neurotic, 30-something, bookstore employee who tries to get by life in dealing with her many random foils and follies (and not to mention her annoying and overbearing parents, Lois and Harold). Thanks to her friends, however, among them including the bubbly redhead Paige, insecure photographer Adam, her unsure-of-himself cousin Spence, coffee shop guy Joe Farrell, and the critical and obnoxious Audrey, Ellen is able to find the security, and the sanity, to get through her less than normal every day life. The show can be described as a combination between popular sitcoms Seinfeld and Friends, blending a perfect mix of comedy and situational humor with the drama and excitement of every day issues and life in the "real world".
title: Ellen

overview: Alice, Micaela, Bruno, Sérgio and Paulo get together, ten days after Patricia's unexpected death. Together, they open the bottle of origamis to fulfill her dreams, among which there are bizarre and illegal requests.
title: A Lista

overview: In a high-quality and comprehensive presentation, ORF III narrates the history of our country from its very beginnings.
title: Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte

overview: FOX Business LIVE at 12 PM, delivers real-time breaking news, market updates, and expert analysis. Featuring exclusive interviews with top industry leaders, it provides viewers with critical insights to stay informed and ahead on issues that affect their wallet .
title: FOX Business Live

overview: Michael takes us to one of his favourite European cities - the Spanish capital Madrid.
title: Madrid with Michael Portillo

overview: Tracing the history of legendary ships that bear witness to the advances in engineering in the 20th century, this innovative series immerses us in the heart of great naval battles. With unpublished archive images and 3D models of realistic photos in 4K.
title: Navires de légende

overview: Artists signed to Atlanta's hottest record label, the Dirty A, navigate shady record deals, greed, and jealousy while trying to live their best lives.

overview: Death of the Party takes a look at mysterious murder stories linked to house parties, banquets, concerts, festivals, or events. There's no environment like a party to create the perfect recipe for cold blooded murder. Each episode looks beyond the party favors and celebratory atmosphere to get to the bottom of the mysterious death that occurred. Did someone have a motive? Was it an accident? Or was it being in the wrong place at the wrong time? Detectives have their work cut out for them as they piece together the events of the evening from inaccurate witness accounts, cagey party goers, and a chaotic crime scene.
title: Death of the Party

overview: Discover the chilling stories of ordinary people who fell victim to the dangers of online dating apps and suffered deadly consequences.
title: Swipe Left or Death

overview: "What's a small-town girl turned L.A. businesswoman to do when her high-profile, high-finance start-up Internet company goes belly up? And when her social life out west is not doing so great either? Well, as played by Emmy winner Ellen DeGeneres, she reacts by saying goodbye to her dot-com world and heading back to her hometown to put her life together. It remains to be seen, however, whether the best way to do that is by becoming a counselor at her old high school--they still teach Home Economics, for crying out loud--and by moving in with her eccentric mother and unlucky-in-love sister." "Ellen Richmond (DeGeneres)...decides to trade the stresses of her fast-track, big-city lifestyle for the slower pace of her quieter hometown, where she is known and loved. It remains to be seen, however, whether or not returning to her hometown, a fishbowl of a place, and her eccentric mother, Dot (C...
title: The Ellen Show

overview: After finally getting over his toxic relationship with a gay woman who broke his heart, Bruce finds himself in another pickle with a new partner.
title: The Lesbian Homie

overview: Idyllic vacations turn deadly, unraveling mysteries of betrayal, deceit, and gruesome murder.
title: Murdered in Paradise

overview: Adult content creators move into a house to help grow each other's fanbase on OnlyFans, TikTok & Instagram. In this house, they better bring the heat!
title: House of Heat

overview: The Lake Winnipeg Project is a documentary that calls attention to stories of ingenuity and resilience among the Anishinaabe, Cree, and Métis communities of Matheson Island, Poplar River First Nation, Fisher River Cree Nation, and Camp Morningstar, at a time when many external forces are imposing change. Highlights their responses to various challenges and factors such as a shifting climate, industrial encroachment, government policy, and the COVID-19 pandemic, among others. Anishinaabe/Cree director Kevin Settee takes an "own-voices" approach to storytelling that gives Lake Winnipeg communities and peoples the opportunity to tell their own stories, in their own voices, and to speak to the challenges and successes experienced within their communities.
title: The Lake Winnipeg Project

overview: This January, join acclaimed Torres Strait Islander chef and cultural ambassador Nornie Bero on a vibrant journey through the breathtaking landscapes and rich traditions of her homeland in her brand-new series, Island Echoes with Nornie Bero. Nornie explores the unique stories, flavours and histories of the Torres Strait Islands, showcasing the diverse cultures that thrive in this remote paradise. Known for her passion for Indigenous cuisine and storytelling, Nornie invites viewers into her world as she cooks traditional dishes using locally sourced ingredients, while also sharing the customs of her Ancestors. From fishing with local communities to participating in traditional ceremonies, Nornie connects the past with the present, highlighting the resilience and creativity of the Torres Strait people. Island Echoes with Nornie Bero is not just a cooking show; it's a celebration of culture, community, and connection to the land. Each episode includes a feast, where Nornie and her guests reflect on the importance of heritage, sustainability, and the power of food to bring people together. In the series, Nornie returns to her roots on Mer Island, a place steeped in cultural significance and personal memories, where she reflects on her journey as a chef and cultural advocate while reconnecting with the vibrant community that shaped her. Throughout the journey, discover traditions that have been passed down through generations and explore many incredible locations and recipes of the Torres Strait including island scallops with ocean seasoning in Badu Island, musu steak with wattle seed in Moa and a delicious fresh Masig seafood platter in Masig. In Island Echoes, discover the echoes of the past that resonate through the vibrant culture of the Torres Strait Islands and be inspired to cherish and celebrate the stories that shape our world.
title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero

overview: Documentary miniseries about the former Queen of the Netherlands, Beatrix.
title: Beatrix

overview: People who are not considered to be sick and have no underlying illnesses visit the clinic and undertake an extensive health scan. Hours later they will find out if they truly are well, or if something has been found that requires further investigation, starting with their GP.

overview: 23-year-old Josh Clayton mysteriously disappeared off one of Britain's private islands. He was last seen at a party hosted by a member of the aristocratic Dorrien-Smith family. Now, Josh's family must explore the dark rumours surrounding his death.

overview: Genius hacker Tobias and his best friend Marco are determined to become the tech billionaires of the future. When they come on the radar of the Irish mafia, the notorious Walsh family, they are inadvertently dragged into the dangerous and cutthroat world of European drug trafficking.
title: Safe Harbor

overview: 20-year-old Elena, rushing to a date with handsome Igor, goes down into an underground passage and comes out 30 years older. Trying to understand what happened to her, Elena learns about a magic medallion that grants youth to its owner, taking it from others. Now the heroine will have to not only get her beauty back, but also understand that you have to fight for your happiness at any age.
title: Украденная красота

overview: The infamous football player Anton Korolev swaps bodies with a simple courier after an accident with a falling elevator. Anton's body is in a coma, and now he has to live someone else's and very earthly life, where there is no more fame and money, but there is someone else's wife and children to take care of. In addition, watching what is happening from the outside, Korolev sees the real motives of his past environment, which makes him look at the world differently.
title: Дублёр

overview: Student Polina, having decided that the most important thing in life is still love, refuses an internship abroad and marries the guy of her dreams. 15 years pass, now she is a housewife with three children, tired of everyday and everyday problems. In her heart, Polina says: "I want everything to be different!" And wakes up in an alternative reality, where she, having once chosen a career, became successful and wealthy, but did not acquire a strong relationship. Meanwhile, Polina the careerist ends up in the family of Polina the housewife, to her children, because she was also dissatisfied with her life and wished for a new one. In order to return back, both women will have to reconsider their life principles in search of harmony.
title: Другая жизнь

overview: Loremasters is the official Warhammer lore show, presented by experts. Each episode dives into the rich worlds of Warhammer and lifts the lid on the iconic characters, locations, and events that have defined Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar from the beginning.
title: Loremasters

overview: Art graduate student Yu Xing is forced by his professor to spend a month teaching at a rural high school as a substitute teacher in the hopes that the change of scenery will inspire Yu Xing and help him salvage his rejected graduation project. Upon his arrival, Yu Xing meets Xu Lu Hui, a cheerful high school student with a passion for painting but limited opportunities to pursue it. While their initial interactions aren't the smoothest, the two eventually strike up a deal together: if Lu Hui drives Yu Xing to outdoor sketch locations, Yu Xing will give Lu Hui private art lessons outside school hours. As they spend more time together and their bond deepens, Lu Hui begins to develop feelings for his substitute teacher. What will become of this forbidden romance?
title: Impression of Youth

overview: The Korean War: Fire and Ice is a 1999 documentary that provides a comprehensive look at the Korean War. It includes wartime footage, voice-over, and on-camera commentary from veterans and military historians. The documentary covers key events and battles from the conflict and highlights the experiences of those who lived through the war.
title: The Korean War: Fire and Ice

overview: Live coverage of the Australian surfing competition.
title: Shaw And Partners Iron Series

overview: Here there is room to investigate and be part of what happens when curious children encounter funny, cute and exciting animals. For our youngest viewers.
title: Mini Oiii

overview: For newsagent Grundy, the need to keep a constant vigil against the permissive society lies heavy on the wreckage of his marriage.
title: Grundy

overview: Experience the liberation of Western Europe from every angle, as astonishingly colorized and expertly restored footage bring the historic turning point of World War II back to vivid life.
title: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin

overview: Dive into the murky world of spies, lies and secrets surrounding the most secretive place in Australia. Pine Gap has been called a space base, a spy base, an obscenity hidden on the fringe of an outback Australian town.
title: Spies In The Outback

overview: New Year's show from the VKontakte company. Unusual interpretation of famous songs and unimaginable duets and collaborations.

overview: When he is suddenly thrust into the supernatural realm, a teenage boy must quickly learn how to banish ghosts and save his town, friends, and family.
title: Spooksoeker

overview: Return of the Pied Piper In the Middle Ages he kidnapped 130 children. Now the Pied Piper of Hamelin is returning with them after almost eight centuries. Only a blind woman, a deaf man and a person with a walking disability can stop him. In present-day Hamelin, the blind Finja meets the deaf Jannik, who claims to have seen Finja and Ruben, a boy with a walking disability, in his dreams. The young people Finja, Jannik and Ruben witness mysterious events that seem to have something to do with the Pied Piper of Hamelin. Is the legend just an old myth or will the three soon have to fear for their own lives?
title: Hameln

overview: Raquel Accioli is the opposite of her daughter, Maria de Fátima, an ambitious and unscrupulous young woman who sells the family home and goes to Rio de Janeiro in search of fortune. Raquel, on the other hand, deals with a personal drama involving Ivan and a financial mystery.
title: Vale Tudo

overview: The Anfield Wrap travelled to Glatten, Frankfurt, Mainz, Dortmund and around Liverpool to hear unique stories from the German's journey, told by those who know him best. The five part docu-series explores five recurring themes throughout Jürgen's story — challenge, Blueprint, journey, winning and legacy — and features footballers that played with and under him, friends that stood by his side through thick and thin, colleagues that helped him move to the next level and the fans that gave him their undying support throughout.
title: Jürgen

overview: The host of the show SHENA invites guests to talk about how music influences their lives — and listen to demos of up-and-coming artists. With the help of a mind tracker, we track sincere reactions and choose with our hearts those tracks that will be officially released and will appear on the VK Music showcase at the end of the season.
title: ВКАТИТ

overview: Xiaoyue, a museum exhibit administrator, meets the maid Yaoyao and constable Mr. Qin from the Western Han Dynasty due to an accident. Yaoyao and Wang Xiao, Xiaoyue's mother, are swapped due to mysterious forces. Wang Xiao is taken back to the Western Han Dynasty while Yaoyao stays in the modern world. Xiaoyue and Yaoyao strive to find a way to travel through time and finally uncover the secrets of Lady Xin Zhui and Li Xi.
title: The Relic Keeper

overview: Six filmmakers adapt classic movies through a contemporary lens, tackling modern-day issues surrounding identity.
title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives

overview: Set in the country's top ski resort follows a young, charismatic crew across the winter 2022 as they manage 6,000 people on each mountain each day of the season
title: Snow Crew

overview: It's a crisis! Rita, 50, discovers that her husband, Olivier, has cheated on her. But Rita and Olivier have been together for thirty years, with four children, and when she's not looking after them, Rita helps Olivier by doing the accounting for his garage-body shop. But who is this "other" woman? Olympe, 38, a senior executive at Valières, a major French luxury leather goods brand, is the opposite of Rita. A powerful woman, she comes from a very privileged background. A workaholic and ambitious, she's chic, beautiful, and has a CV as long as your arm. Rita decides to confront her and goes to the Valières headquarters. But nothing goes as planned. And while Rita has every reason to hate Olympe, and Olympe to distrust Rita, Rita will on the contrary, even though she knows nothing about the world of luxury,... become Olympe's assistant! Forced to work together, how long can such a duo last?

overview: Lucy Kennedy is taken out of her comfort zone as she immerses herself in four unique lifestyle groups in Ireland, that reflect the lives of young Irish people, as she sets out to ask some deeper questions about these parts of Irish society that rarely get time in the spotlight.
title: Lucy Investigates

overview: This long-running drama dealt with the experiences of a group of young people in Beverly Hills, CA as they navigated high school, college and ultimately the real world. The series focused on their travails as they tried to maintain their friendship while dealing with romances, family and personal crises, tragedies and countless drug addictions.
title: Beverly Hills, 90210

overview: A middle-class woman contemplating suicide becomes involved with a suspected killer on the run.

overview: Japanese design is world famous, but that's not because of expensive, stylish or modern products. It's because excellent design exists within the tools and habits of everyday life. In this 10-part series, leading creators visit different parts of the country to hear these unfamiliar stories, revealing rich and complex insights.
title: DESIGN MUSEUM JAPAN

overview: A cutting-edge interview program from NHK WORLD-JAPAN's production team in New York. Covers the hot issue: from politics, economy, social matters, international situation or cultural topics.
title: Deeper Look

overview: Japan Delish is a banquet of foods from overseas adopted by the Japanese. From fare steeped in tradition to its many modern variations, uncover the delicious histories at the heart of every dish.
title: Japan Delish

overview: Traditional festivals called matsuri are found all over Japan. In this series, we present diverse matsuri and the preparations leading up to them. Each matsuri presents a new face of local Japan.
title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan

overview: Ninja are now seen in popular media around the world. But as their profile rises, their reality gets muddied amid legends and fantasies. The truth about authentic ninja lies unknown, shrouded in mystery. This program carefully examines the fighting skills and tools used by actual ninja, and conducts experiments to determine the "Ninja Truth".
title: Ninja Truth

overview: Pianos are placed in airports, stations and on street corners around the world for anyone to play. Join us in unraveling the life stories of performers through the eyes of fixed cameras.
title: My Street Piano

overview: Do you know what "origami" is? It is a magic made from a single sheet of paper. This program showcases the creations of artists from around the globe inspired by the Japanese traditional craft.
title: Origami Magic

overview: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.
title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE

overview: This miniseries presents the masterpieces of Tsutaju, a brilliant ukiyo-e producer of the Edo period.

overview: Japan has 34 national parks. Rich in diverse natural attractions, they've been protected by those who call it home and are symbols of Japan's bond with nature.
title: National Parks of Japan

overview: Join chef Kogawa Nobuko and her husband Makoto as they take us on a culinary journey through the seasons featuring traditional recipes unique to the mountainous region of Hida Takayama in Gifu Prefecture.
title: Satoyama Kitchen Diary

overview: In the early years of the Ming Dynasty, turmoil swept through the martial world as various sects, driven by greed, waged war against one another in pursuit of the power of the Four Divine Artifacts. Amid this great catastrophe, the chivalrous hero Gao Lingfeng, while uncovering the truth behind a city's destruction and the mystery of his own origins, crosses paths with Sun Chenxi. As paragons of courage and justice, the two join forces to eliminate villains and thwart the sinister schemes of Xuanhuo Sect. Eventually, they succeed in obtaining one of the Four Divine Artifacts, the Azure Dragon's Essence, and Gao Lingfeng finally unravels the secrets behind his past. Together, he and Sun Chenxi take on the solemn duty of seeking the remaining artifacts to safeguard peace across the land...
title: Legacy of the Storm

overview: An unsuspecting city dwelling single returns home to visit their small town parents, and is met with three potential dates. These suitors have been carefully selected by their parents and community, hopeful they will find love.
title: Small Town Setup

overview: The plot tells the story of Sinhá Moça, daughter of the powerful Colonel Ferreira, the slave owner Baron of Araruna, and Cândida. A dreamer and a romantic, Sinhá Moça falls in love with Rodolfo, an active abolitionist republican. She meets the young man on the train, when she travels back to Araruna after finishing her studies in the capital of the province. Like Rodolfo, Sinhá Moça has abolitionist ideas and criticizes her father's actions, fighting in defense of black people. Together with Rodolfo and other young abolitionists, she fights for the liberation of slaves.
title: Sinhá Moça

overview: Celebrity chef Anna Haugh is embarking on a culinary journey from Ballycastle in County Antrim to Cork city for Anna Haugh's Big Irish Food Tour. Anna will be travelling around Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland, exploring the culture and cuisine of her home. In each episode, Anna will be joined by a celebrity guest to meet the people behind some local produce and sample an array of ingredients and flavours the island of Ireland has to offer.
title: Anna Haugh's Big Irish Food Tour

overview: Josh and Charlie, a couple without marriage or kids, undertake renovating their dilapidated dream home, facing challenges and strengthening their bond as they build a life together through this project.
title: DINKs

overview: The colourful couple Lisa and Henrik Borg open the door to their life together. Their relationship is the centrepiece, where we see how they support each other through all the trials and triumphs.
title: Borgs 24/7

overview: Get lost in the world of Gus and his simple, lovable charm as he embarks on imaginative adventures with his zany, faithful sidekick, Karrot. Learn about the elementary mysteries of life with their whimsical, friend Lucy as their guide.
title: Gus Plus Us

overview: Middle-aged Linda, accustomed to the good life, is completely betrayed both in love and financially. Driven by shame and unreasonable debts, she sticks her little finger out on the other side of the law and stays there. Linda harnesses her talents to the construction and renovation business and, by stretching her morals, manages to climb to the top.
title: Queen of Fucking Everything

overview: There will be revelations, laughter and tears when famous people are challenged by atypical reporters with critical, surprising and unfiltered questions.
title: A-laget

overview: More and more people dream of a simple life in the countryside, with less stress and more harmony. Ida and Sverre are making that dream come true.

overview: Who are the koftepoliti, and what is the strangest thing the Sámi Parliament has given money to? A sidelong look at Sámi stereotypes and other minor problems in Sápmi.
title: Hurri

overview: A new TNT humor project in which comedians will challenge the fortune of humor to catch a cash prize by the tail. Ilya Sobolev, the main "toxic" of the humorous scene, will give participants the opportunity to earn money from jokes, and at the same time test themselves for luck. Each of them goes on stage and jokes for one minute. If the audience thinks that the joke is funny, then a certain amount of money falls into the general pot. After the performance, the comedian stands at the end of the "queue", and the next one comes to the microphone. Whoever remains last will get the opportunity to increase the pot and take everything for themselves.
title: Стендап рулетка
